system.summary: Shanghai → “Rosamonde” and Tokyo → “Junzaburo”, February–May 1915; clear indicator “Thirtieth”. Table recovered in October 2026.

prior_solution.where: Not in this repository (pointer only in sunyatsen/y1916); no decipherment on the JACAR copies; Cryptiana checked.

conditions.human_role: Brice Dudout set the rules and re-read doubtful letters on the scans in blind panels; AI agents transcribed, searched the condenser family, decoded and translated.
models: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), agents run by Brice Dudout

solution.what: Telegrams transcribed from the JACAR PDFs; doubtful letters re-read by Brice Dudout in blind panels.
Search of the condenser family (consonant rotation, vowel order) scored with a Chinese character model; key accepted only if it read telegrams it was not fitted to.
Chinese text punctuated and translated; doubtful codes marked.
Read share recounted with sure codes only (README rule of PR #728) from the status column of decryption.txt: 237 of 263 codes (0.901); 7 of 10 telegrams under 95%; class read -> read in part.
Floor for short texts (README, 19 Nov 2026: under 40 codes, at most 2 holes) applied to the 18 Nov counts: 0220 (17/19), 0224 (23/25), 0246 (6/7), 0255 (23/25) read; class stays read in part.

validation.notes: Chinese plaintext through the telegraph code: the letter n-gram test cannot run on Chinese characters; the readings were checked by sense

outcome.fraction_read_source: Sure codes only (18 Nov 2026): 237 of 263 codes marked ok (or confirmed) in decryption.txt; doubtful and illegible codes are holes; 7 of 10 telegrams under 95%. Before: probable (doubtful) codes counted as read. Floor for short texts (README, 19 Nov 2026): 0220 (17/19), 0224 (23/25), 0246 (6/7), 0255 (23/25) now read; 0211 (33/36), 0233b (16/23), 0243 (26/32) stay under the bar, so the class stays read in part.

reading_review.note: 10 telegrams on funds and Inuzuka, Shanghai 1915; all build sense, 0261 (Kang-Liang alliance) long and clean; 0243 has a garbled middle ({鬍}人尤難{情}{呷}{丐}) and 0233b a doubtful opening, both left as gaps in the translation.

texts.note: 18 Nov 2026, sure codes only: 33 of 36 codes "ok" in decryption.txt (91.7%); codes marked doubtful (douteux, {x} in reading.md) or illegible are holes.
